title: Telemetry Step-Down: hypermagnesemia from over-the-counter magnesium with acute kidney injury on CKD, emergent hemodialysis (24 h in 4-hour checkpoints)
diagnosis: Hypermagnesemia (Mg 7.8 rising to 10.9 mg/dL) after weeks of OTC magnesium products, acute kidney injury on CKD stage 4, respiratory depression, emergent hemodialysis, post-dialysis hypoglycemia and magnesium rebound
desc: Tue 0700 to Wed 0700 in seven 4-hour checkpoints: a lethargic, bradycardic man with CKD 4 and AKI who took milk of magnesia, a Mg antacid and magnesium oxide; calcium gluconate, fluids and diuretic, deterioration with respiratory depression, emergent hemodialysis, hypoglycemia after dialysis, magnesium rebound with delirium and constipation, then recovery teaching. Includes an instructor guide with bedside-monitor settings and a debriefing.
